facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but 15% of foreign earnings must be converted to kyat at official rates.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Partly: foreign currency must be deposited at local banks, with part converted.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local wallets like KBZPay and Wave Money weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Not confirmed for sole proprietors; individual businesses usually need township licences.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 1–25%; tax on foreign-currency income is paid in that currency.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No VAT; commercial tax of 5% on services above MMK 50 million.
facts.L5_data_protection: No personal data law; the 2025 Cybersecurity Law requires platforms to keep user data.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: Sanctions and FATF listing mean foreign banks apply extra checks.
